job.rawJd: As an Account Executive at WEX, you are the accountable owner of the post-sale client relationship, responsible for delivering value, strengthening partnerships, and ensuring long-term customer success. You are responsible for protecting and growing accounts, minimizing attrition, driving renewals, and ensuring a world-class client experience. You will serve as the strategic partner and trusted advisor to clients by understanding their goals, operations, and industry, then aligning WEX solutions to help them grow. Your impact will influence account growth and annual recurring revenue through proactive engagement, strategic planning, product enablement, adoption, retention, and loyalty. Within the Mid-market team, you will balance strategic customer engagements with one-to-many digital education and product-awareness programs. Responsibilities include serving as the primary post-sale point of contact; building long-term relationships; understanding client KPIs and growth strategies; leading touchpoints, planning sessions, and business reviews; owning account growth and retention; identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities; leading renewals; using quarterly business reviews to demonstrate ROI and build expansion roadmaps; guiding clients through product best practices and advanced features; developing enablement plans; driving utilization and preventing churn; coordinating with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve issues; sharing product updates; gathering customer feedback; maintaining accurate client and opportunity records; and reporting on satisfaction, renewals, and revenue expansion. Qualifications include 3-5 years of Customer Success or Account Executive experience; a bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience; advanced knowledge of HSA, HRA, FSA, Commuter, COBRA, Retiree Billing, and FMLA Billing preferred; strong knowledge of Savings & Spending and COBRA regulatory requirements; a proven record managing client relationships and driving account growth; experience with renewals, expansions, and retention and revenue targets; strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills; high accountability; cross-functional and independent work; and proficiency with CRM and client-engagement platforms such as Salesforce. The posted base pay range is $58,500-$70,800.
